pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal geometries with rounded vertices. Edge gradients are diffuse and low-contrast. Relative spatial area of individual patches is greater on the mid-flank than on the lower cervical region.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-toned pathways forming a topological grid. Junction nodes are predominantly trivalent. Pixel thickness of corridors is non-uniform, appearing wider in the cervical-thoracic transition zone.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Dark, linear silhouette along the neck exhibiting low-frequency, irregular serrations. The amplitude of the jagged peaks is moderate against the background luminance.

other_distinctive_markers: Two avian organisms (Oxpeckers) are perched on the dorsal ridge; one at the neck-shoulder junction and one on the posterior dorsal midline.
